en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abdullah Bin Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Ibn Sinan, from Sabiq Bin Al Waleed, from Al Moalla Bin Khunays that, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said:

‘Hameeda is as refined from the pollution like and ingot of gold. The Angels did not cease to guard her until she was to me<sup>asws</sup> as a prestige from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for me, and the Divine Authority from after me<sup>asws</sup>’.
